newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE Dec white sugar expiry subdued in thin trade.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE Dec white sugar expiry subdued in thin trade.

text.p: London's December white sugar expiry proceeded quietly on Friday and a low volume of physical delivery was expected when the contract expires at close of business, traders said.
One leading commission house was reported to be selling any December positions in the few hours remaining before expiry, and some light trade buying of the position was also seen.
The December/March switch, a focus of trading earlier in the week, drew very little interest and turnover was thin at 813 lots by 1620 GMT.

December was up $1.00 at $305.50 and March down 20 cents at $303.50. Other positions were slightly weaker. Traders said Poland was likely to feature as an origin for physical deliveries against December, noting that some trade houses had already floated freight orders for Gdynia and Gdansk.

The Paris market was listless with just 329 lots traded. December, which also expires on Friday, was unchanged with 150 lots traded and March was 30 cents lower at $303.50, the same as its London equivalent.
